official: 東京都台東区立小中学校等の学校医、学校歯科医及び学校薬剤師の公務災害補償に関する条例の一部を改正する条例

令和8年第2回定例会の会議結果

name: 学校医・歯科医の補償基準額を改定
summary: 学校医と学校歯科医の公務災害補償には、補償基礎額が定められています。この議案で、該当する補償基礎額を改定します。改定後の額は令和8年4月1日以降に支給事由が生じた補償などに適用し、条例は公布日から施行します。
changes: 補償基礎額を14,175円から14,397円に改める
補償基礎額を14,175円から15,198円に改める
補償基礎額を16,467円から17,259円に改める
補償基礎額を17,496円から17,937円に改める
who: 公務災害補償を受ける学校医
公務災害補償を受ける学校歯科医
why: 補償基礎額を改定するためと、区長は説明しています。

en.name: Revises compensation base amounts for school doctors and dentists
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Ordinance on Compensation for Work-Related Accidents of School Doctors, School Dentists, and School Pharmacists at Taito City Municipal Elementary and Junior High Schools, etc.
en.summary: Compensation for work-related accidents involving school doctors and school dentists is based on set compensation base amounts. This bill revises the applicable amounts. The revised amounts will apply to compensation and other payments for which the grounds for payment arise on or after April 1, 2026. The ordinance will take effect on the date it is promulgated.
changes: Raises the compensation base amount from ¥14,175 to ¥14,397
Raises the compensation base amount from ¥14,175 to ¥15,198
Raises the compensation base amount from ¥16,467 to ¥17,259
Raises the compensation base amount from ¥17,496 to ¥17,937
who: School doctors receiving work-related accident compensation
School dentists receiving work-related accident compensation
en.why: The mayor says this is to revise the compensation base amounts.
